# Scenario: include and extends are skipped so host filesystem compose
# fragments cannot leak services. README Compose Include/Extends Guard.

mkdir outside
cp leaked.yml outside/leaked.yml

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'

# Absolute host paths must appear in the committed compose blob.
exec sh -c 'sed "s|__LEAKED__|$WORK/outside/leaked.yml|g" ../compose.guard.yml > dev/e2e-guard/docker-compose.yml'

exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: include extends guard fixture'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='

docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-guard-web

# Leaked service must never start (include/extends ignored).
exec sh -c '! docker ps -a --format "{{.Names}}" | grep -qi leaked'

exists $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-guard/docker-compose.yml
grep 'web:' $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-guard/docker-compose.yml
! grep 'leaked' $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-guard/docker-compose.yml
! grep 'include:' $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-guard/docker-compose.yml
! grep 'extends:' $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-guard/docker-compose.yml

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- leaked.yml --
services:
  leaked:
    image: alpine:latest
    command: sh -c "while true; do sleep 3600; done"

-- compose.guard.yml --
include:
  - path: __LEAKED__
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    extends:
      file: __LEAKED__
      service: leaked
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-guard
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9995
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-guard/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]

-- .env --
